# TDPdf v1.30.2.0

**Follow-up to 1.30.1.0.** Buttons inside the printer's Properties dialog that open a further dialog now work.

## Fixed

### Sub-dialogs inside Printer Properties never appeared

On the Toshiba drivers this is the **Dual Print** button; most vendor drivers have an equivalent panel behind a button of their own. Pressing it did nothing — in TDPdf only. The same button in any other application opened its dialog normally.

The dialog was being created; it just never became visible.

The cause is TDPdf's own window styling. Custom chrome — the rounded corners and drop shadow on the print window — requires per-pixel transparency, which makes it a *layered* window. The driver's main property sheet copes with a layered owner. The secondary dialogs it opens from its own buttons do not: they are created and then never shown. It's the same family as WPF's long-standing airspace limitation, and it is exactly why the button worked everywhere except here.

The driver is now handed an ordinary, unstyled window to own its dialog, rather than the print window itself. That window is zero-sized, never appears in the taskbar or Alt-Tab, and sits at the centre of the print window so drivers that centre their dialogs on their owner still land in the right place.

Everything else about the dialog is unchanged: it still sits above the print window, still blocks it while it's open, and everything set in it still reaches the job — that was 1.30.1.0.

## Installing

Managed machines update through Intune automatically; nothing to do. Otherwise it's the same self-contained `TDPdf.exe`.
